messages:
Ava (Partnerships): Heads-up — DST cutover for EU regions is next weekend. We need a concrete runbook for marketplace usage ingestion and billing so partners don’t get double-charged or missed hours.
Sam (Billing): Agreed. Past cutovers caused 1-2 hour gaps for hourly SKUs. Goal: zero-customer-impact if possible, otherwise clear grace/adjustment policy.
Ravi (Infra): Short version of the technical risk: our collectors use local timestamps from partner connectors. When clocks jump forward/back an hour, we either drop or duplicate a batch depending on pipeline dedupe windows.
Jules (Solutions): For SI partners that bridge multiple timezones, we also saw entitlement windows misalign with partner reports. Need to confirm partner-side behavior.
Kai (SRE): Proposal: freeze automated ingestion window changes during the 2-hour cutover window and route partner ingestion through a temporary holding queue. That lets us manually reconcile before commit.
Sam (Billing): Holding queue => manual reconciliation implies billing lag. What SLA can we promise partners? Recommend: max 24h delay for final billed usage, with provisional estimates used for dashboards.
Ava (Partnerships): Sounds reasonable. We need to notify partners with exact cutover window and expected dashboard vs billed lag. Draft notice and approval?
Jules (Solutions): I'll draft partner note. Also we should publish a short checklist for SI connectors: ensure connector clocks are NTP-synced, avoid local-only rounding, and include event_id in each usage event.
Ravi (Infra): Implementation checklist for us:
1) Toggle pipeline to drain mode at T-30m.
2) Switch collectors to 'hold' mode at T-10m so they enqueue to holding-queue.
3) After cutover, replay holding-queue into dedupe stage with extended dedupe window (+2h).
4) Run reconciliation job to compare partner-reported totals vs ingested totals and surface differences.
I'll paste the commands we'll use in ops playbook.
Kai (SRE): What about connectors that restart during DST? They may re-emit recent windows. Our dedupe needs to be idempotent by event_id + partner_id. If event_id is missing, fallback to timestamp+hash with TTL=72h.
Sam (Billing): Billing rules:
- If ingestion lag < 6h, bill as normal.
- If 6h <= lag <= 24h, tag usage as 'pending-adjustment' and don't finalize invoices until reconciliation complete.
- If >24h, credit estimate and then apply adjustment on next invoice.
We need to communicate these to legal and revenue ops.
Ava (Partnerships): Assign owners: Partnerships (Ava) will send partner notice, Solutions (Jules) will send connector checklist, Infra (Ravi) owns pipeline flags and replay, SRE (Kai) owns dedupe/holding infra, Billing (Sam) owns adjustment policy and comms to RevOps.
Jules (Solutions): I'll post the connector checklist in partner-ops and tag the top 10 SIs. Also propose a short smoke test partners can run 24h before cutover: send 2 synthetic events with explicit event_id and confirm they appear in dashboard within 5m.
billing-bot: Automated reminder scheduled: "DST cutover - partner notice draft due in 72h"
Ravi (Infra): Ops playbook snippets (for runbook):
```
# drain collectors
curl -X POST https://internal-api/collectors/flags -d '{"mode":"drain"}'
# hold mode
curl -X POST https://internal-api/collectors/flags -d '{"mode":"hold","hold_queue":"dst-hold-1778883333"}'
# replay after cutover
python ops/replay_hold.py --queue dst-hold-1778883333 --dedupe-window 7200
```
Kai (SRE): Reconciliation query pattern (SQL):
```
SELECT partner_id, sku, count(*) as events, sum(units) as units FROM ingested_usage
WHERE processed_at BETWEEN '2026-03-28T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-28T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY partner_id, sku;
```
Compare to partner reports by partner_report_id. Flag mismatches >0.5% for manual review.
Sam (Billing): Edge cases: subscriptions with hourly-prorated SKUs — we will run a special prorate job that checks for "missing hour" events and applies a credit if partner-provided evidence is accepted. Need RevOps playbook for manual credits and audit trail.
Ava (Partnerships): Timeline:
- Today: finalize partner notice and checklist (Ava/Jules)
- T-72h: send notice to partners and top SI owners
- T-24h: partners run smoke test and confirm
- T-1h: Infra/Kai set collectors to drain/hold as per runbook
- Cutover: execute holding + replay with extended dedupe
- T+6h: initial reconciliation results posted to ops channel
- T+24h: billing finalize/adjust as per policy
Jules (Solutions): I'll also prepare a short KB for partners describing how to ensure event_id idempotency and NTP sync.
Kai (SRE): Postmortem template: include timeline, number of affected partner accounts, total billed delta, mitigation actions. We'll auto-open a postmortem issue if more than 5 partners report discrepancies.
Sam (Billing): I'll loop in RevOps and Legal after this thread. One ask: please freeze any scheduled invoice finalizations for the affected region during the 48h window.
Ava (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll circulate the draft notice in ~2 hours and create a formal runbook doc. If no objections, we'll proceed with this plan. :thumbsup:
